# SignalFlow Studio

> SignalFlow Studio is an open-source, review-first campaign workspace that turns product notes, public links, GitHub repository context, and uploaded text files into editable drafts for twelve publishing destinations.

## Use this summary

SignalFlow helps founders, developers, creators, and small teams prepare one coherent campaign instead of rewriting the same product update separately for every channel. Users add source context, select destinations, choose a deterministic local template or a supported model route, review each draft, and then export it or use a genuinely configured publishing path.

## Core capabilities

- Creates editable drafts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Reddit, Facebook, Threads, YouTube, TikTok, Hacker News, newsletters, blogs, and release notes.
- Extracts context from public links and public GitHub repositories.
- Reads supported text, Markdown, CSV, JSON, and code files in the browser.
- Includes a deterministic local template route that needs no API key.
- Supports Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Groq, Ollama, LM Studio, and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
- Saves campaign packages in the current browser and exports Markdown or JSON.
- Offers direct publishing only through configured official LinkedIn, X, and Reddit connectors after explicit review.
- Treats image and video uploads as asset references in the active route; it does not claim automatic visual understanding.

## Important limitations

- Every generated output is a draft and must be fact-checked and edited before use.
- Direct publishing is not available for every destination.
- A publish action is shown as successful only after the destination API confirms it.
- The public hosted instance may require owner access for server-configured providers and social connectors.
- llms.txt is provided as machine-readable product context; it does not guarantee search ranking or AI citation.
